_help: Optional. Add an entry keyed by the Tuesday date. Each fuel can be a single number or a [low, high] range in PHP per liter (rollback is negative), e.g. "2026-11-17": { "gasoline": -4.70, "diesel": -6.40, "kerosene": -6.90, "source": "Name of the estimator" }. The forecast then blends it 50/50 with the market model, and the page shows both numbers.
